title: Hypergeometric Draw Odds
description:
An informational overlay that adds native-style draw-chance analysis to the combat Draw Pile, Discard Pile, and a new combined ALL screen.

Hover any card to see the chance of drawing an identical copy and the chance of drawing that exact physical card. Select cards to see the chance of drawing at least one of them, at least N of them (ANY), or every one of them (ALL).

The calculation is the hypergeometric 1 - C(N-K, n) / C(N, n), and it respects the game's real draw order: the draw pile is consumed first, and discard cards only become reachable when the next hand crosses a reshuffle. No-draw effects, hand-draw modifiers, retain effects, and maximum hand size are all accounted for.

Purely informational: it changes no gameplay and declares affects_gameplay false.
